name: HUAPANXISU
aiSummary: What are the check-in and check-out times at HUAPANXISU?
address: Moganshan town houwu village, Deqing, Zhejiang, 313202, China
priceRange: Unbeatable daily deals - quickly find great rates for your ideal stay. And if it's cheaper elsewhere, we'll refund the difference.

comments.quote: 性價比非常好的一家民宿。地址在離景區不遠的後塢，開車20分鐘內可到達景區散客換乘中心。説實話後塢夜晚更有意思，有集市，有露天酒吧，有燒烤，龍蝦啤酒，還有鄉村特色的舞台劇表演。很推薦住在後塢。酒店有三層客房，加一個頂樓露台客房，樓下有室內娛樂區域，足球桌遊，小桌球，飛鏢，還有樂高積木，室外有休閑區，衹是天氣熱了白天沒法坐，晚上有點風還可以。酒店洗澡熱水保障，空調冷氣足，還有豐盛的早餐。很適合自駕家庭旅遊。
comments.author: rockychenyan
comments.quoteEn: Very good value. It is at Houwu, not far from the scenic area, within twenty minutes drive of the visitor transfer centre. Houwu is honestly the more interesting place in the evening, with a market, an open air bar, barbecue, crayfish and beer, and village theatre. I would recommend staying there. The hotel has three floors of rooms plus one on the roof terrace, an indoor games area downstairs with table football, small pool, darts and Lego, and an outdoor seating area, though it is too hot to sit out during the day and only works once there is a breeze in the evening. Reliable hot water, strong air conditioning and a generous breakfast. Well suited to a family driving trip.
